per_hop.query:
SELECT 
  psp.position,
  psp.team AS team_name, 
  gm.name AS general_manager, 
  draft1.player_name AS player_drafted_higher,
  draft2.player_name AS player_drafted_lower,
  cfhof.inducted AS college_hof,
  pfhof.inducted AS pro_hof
FROM personnel_positions psp
JOIN general_managers gm ON psp.general_manager_id = gm.id
JOIN drafts draft1 ON draft1.general_manager_id = gm.id AND draft1.pick_number < draft2.pick_number
JOIN drafts draft2 ON draft2.player_name = 'Steve Little'
LEFT JOIN college_football_hall_of_fame cfhof ON draft1.player_name = cfhof.player_name
LEFT JOIN pro_football_hall_of_fame pfhof ON draft1.player_name = pfhof.player_name
WHERE psp.position = 'Director of Player Personnel'
  AND psp.team = 'Baltimore Ravens'
  AND cfhof.inducted = TRUE
  AND pfhof.inducted = TRUE;

Who was the Baltimore Ravens general manager during Philip Savage’s tenure as Director of Player Personnel? Was Steve Little drafted higher than this general manager? And was this general manager inducted into both the College Football Hall of Fame and the Pro Football Hall of Fame? Additionally, confirm Philip Savage’s role as Director of Player Personnel for the Baltimore Ravens.
